text_block_list.text: Happiness is here! Fortune has arrived!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
What an amazingly lucky outcome! I
took first! A
surprise victory for
Matikanefukukitaru!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
You didn't fail me, Trainer, and neither
did the
great Shiraoki! Just as I
thought...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: The heavens are always smiling upon me!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: Hey, don't get too carried away.

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! No one can come close to rivaling
one such
as me! And that's no
exaggeration!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: What a joyous occasion! Which is why...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: I want you to have this as a thank-you!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: It's a lucky charm that helps with taking the bones out of your sea bream. It's to celebrate the joy that has me bream-ing!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Argh! I know that, obviously! I'm not
getting
carried away, really!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Well, I am being carried by this wave of good luck, though! Ehehe!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
And it's thanks to your guidance that I'm
able to
ride that wave! On that note...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: I want you to have this as a thank-you!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
It's a lucky charm that helps you
befriend surfers!
That way you can catch
some gnarly waves of
your own!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I'm not too sure about the gift, but I
appreciate
the sentiment nonetheless!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
